papers.title: Revealing information -- or not -- in a social network of traders
papers.abstract: We build upon a simple micro-founded model of asset trading proposed by Kyle (1985) to study under what conditions a trader who is privately informed of the future return of the asset may want to share her information with other traders. Despite what conventional wisdom suggests, we show that in the unique equilibrium of the game the informed trader reveals her information with positive probability. A consequence of it is that, in contrast with the corresponding no-communication benchmark, the equilibrium price need not be fully revealing of the asset's return, even if traders are risk neutral. This, in turn, has significant implications on the distribution of the social surplus. While our model initially assumes that inter-agent communication is restricted by an arbitrarily given social network, we also study which such networks arise when links are endogenously formed through traders' prior connection decisions.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】我们在Kyle（1985）提出的一个基于微观基础的资产交易模型基础上进行了扩展，研究在何种条件下，一个能够私下了解资产未来收益信息的交易者可能会愿意与其他交易者分享这一信息。与传统观点相反，我们发现在该博弈的独特均衡状态下，知情交易者以正概率披露其信息。这一结果意味着，与不存在信息交流的基准情况相比，即使交易者是风险中性的，均衡价格也不一定能够完全反映资产的真实收益。这反过来又对社会剩余的分配产生了重要影响。虽然我们的模型最初假设交易者之间的交流受到某个任意给定的社交网络的限制，但我们同时也探讨了当这些网络是通过交易者之前的连接决策内生形成的情况下，会形成什么样的社交网络。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Panel Data Estimation of Individual Demand in Markets with Many Consumers
papers.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to consider whether and how panel data can be used to estimate individual demand, as opposed to market-level demand, while accounting for simultaneity resulting from prices being determined in markets. We consider linear demand models and random coefficient demand models, together with linear supply models. We find that the bias of individual demand estimates obtained using familiar panel data methods, like differencing, disappears as the number of consumers in each market grows, as long as the time-varying, i.e. idiosyncratic, component of preferences is orthogonal to the unobserved, time-varying component of supply. This approximate control is assumed in many panel discrete choice models and is plausible in other models where idiosyncratic preferences represent random variation in preferences over time. Macroeconomic effects can be allowed for by including regressors characterizing time effects, such as trends and time period dummies, or fixed time effects.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文旨在探讨在考虑价格由市场决定所导致的同时性效应的情况下，是否以及如何利用面板数据来估计个体需求（而非市场整体需求）。我们研究了线性需求模型、随机系数需求模型以及线性供给模型。研究发现，只要消费者数量增加，并且偏好中的时变（即特殊性）成分与供给中的未观测时变成分相互独立（即正交），那么使用常见的面板数据分析方法（如差分法）得到的个体需求估计值偏差便会消失。这种近似控制机制在许多面板离散选择模型中被采用；在其他模型中，当特殊性偏好代表随时间变化的随机偏好时，这种假设也是合理的。为了纳入宏观经济效应，可以引入反映时间变化的回归变量，例如趋势变量或时期虚拟变量，或者采用固定时间效应模型。。研究方法：面板数据。

papers.title: HOW MUCH CAN THE MINIMUM WAGE BE INCREASED? A SECTORAL ANALYSIS OF THE 80,000–90,000 AMD RANGE
papers.abstract: The statutory minimum wage in the Republic of Armenia has been 75,000 AMD (gross) per month since January 2023, which is below the officially adopted subsistence level of the consumer basket. This study quantitatively assesses the direct financial burden and impact distribution of three realistic scenarios of increasing the minimum wage to 80,000, 85,000 and 90,000 AMD. The analysis is based on the log-normal distribution applied to data on 784,964 employees registered in the formal sector provided by the Statistical Committee of the Republic of Armenia. The study reveals the structure of beneficiaries by NACE Rev.2 sectors and forms of ownership. Statistical data indicate that about 45% of the additional costs are borne by the state, primarily through salaries in the education sector. At the same time, it is documented that after the imposition of a 20% flat income tax, the disposable net wage remains below the poverty line in all three scenarios considered. The results obtained justify that a gradual increase in the minimum wage should be accompanied by a targeted reduction in the tax wedge at the bottom of the income distribution.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】自2023年1月起，亚美尼亚共和国的法定最低工资为每月75,000亚美尼亚德拉姆（毛额），这一水平低于官方确定的消费者篮子维持生计所需的最低标准。本研究定量评估了将最低工资分别提高到80,000、85,000和90,000亚美尼亚德拉姆三种情景下的直接经济负担及影响分布。分析基于亚美尼亚共和国统计委员会提供的784,964名正规部门员工的统计数据，并采用了对数正态分布模型。研究结果显示，不同行业（按照NACE Rev.2分类标准）和所有制形式中，受益者的构成存在差异。统计数据显示，约45%的额外成本由政府承担，主要体现在教育领域的薪资支出上。同时，研究发现，在征收20%的统一所得税后，三种情景下的可支配净工资仍低于贫困线。研究结果表明，逐步提高最低工资的同时，有必要有针对性地降低收入分配底层群体的税收负担。。

papers.title: What Investment Data Implies about the AI Transition
papers.abstract: The five largest U.S. technology firms spent $380 billion on capital expenditure in 2025 and are forecast to spend roughly double that in 2026. These firms risk bankruptcy unless expected profits grow commensurately. We embed this observation in a two-sector open-economy model with rare productivity booms. We calibrate the boom size to match the observed increase in investment projected through 2027, implying that a boom raises AI-sector productivity by a factor of roughly 2.7. We then calibrate a two-year window of a 50% annual probability of an increase of the same magnitude, generating a range of scenarios consistent with the wide variety of industry forecasts, along with an elevated permanent probability tied to the valuation of the aggregate market. The implied additional cumulative GDP growth ranges from 5 to 58 percentage points by 2030, with AI shares of the economy ranging from 8% to 39%. Long-term annual growth is in expectation approximately 7% but with substantial risk. With risk aversion of 3, and an elasticity of intertemporal substitution equal to 1, the risk-free rate increases by approximately half a percentage point, and the equity premium rises by approximately 3 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】美国五大科技公司在2025年的资本支出总额为3800亿美元，预计2026年的支出将翻一番。除非预期利润相应增长，否则这些公司面临破产的风险。我们将这一观察结果纳入一个包含两个部门、开放经济的模型中，并考虑了罕见的生产率飙升现象。我们根据模型预测的投资增长情况调整了生产率飙升的幅度，发现这种飙升使人工智能（AI）行业的生产力提高了约2.7倍。随后，我们设定了一个为期两年的时间窗口，在此期间每年出现同等幅度生产率提升的概率为50%，从而生成了一系列符合不同行业预测结果的情景。这些情景还反映了与整体市场估值相关的长期风险增加。到2030年，预计GDP的累计增长幅度将在5%至58%之间，AI行业在整个经济中的占比将在8%至39%之间波动。长期年均增长率约为7%，但存在显著风险。在风险厌恶系数为3、跨期替代弹性为1的假设下，无风险利率将上升约0.5个百分点，股票溢价将上升约3个百分点。。

papers.title: Incentives, Evidence, and Reminders for Bureaucrats: Overcoming Barriers to Policy Scale Up
papers.abstract: Scaling up effective policies often requires the attention of frontline bureaucrats with many competing responsibilities. Even when policymakers adopt effective programs, implementation may not follow. In a nationwide experiment in the Dominican Republic, we test interventions to increase school principals' implementation of an educational program proven effective in a previous RCT. Only 37% of control schools verifiably implemented the intervention when ordered to by the Ministry of Education, compared with 83% in the original trial. Implementation was no higher among schools that previously implemented the program in the RCT, suggesting that fixed costs of adoption do not explain non-adoption. We find precise null effects of sharing research evidence, providing modest financial incentives, or offering implementation assistance to principals. In contrast, additional reminder calls increased implementation by 20 percentage points. A second experiment targeting a different mandated program yields the same pattern: reminders produce large effects, while monitoring messages have smaller effects. Our findings point to limited attention among bureaucrats as an important barrier to scaling policies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】扩大有效政策的实施范围往往需要一线官僚的关注，而这些官僚通常肩负着多项相互竞争的职责。即便政策制定者采纳了有效的方案，其实施过程也可能难以顺利进行。在多米尼加共和国开展的一项全国性实验中，我们测试了多种干预措施，旨在提高学校校长对先前随机对照试验（RCT）中已被证明有效的教育方案的执行力度。结果显示：当教育部下达执行指令时，仅有37%的对照学校真正实施了该方案，而在原始试验中这一比例为83%。即使在那些之前已在RCT中实施过该方案的学校中，执行率也没有提高，这表明采用该方案的固定成本并不能解释为何有些学校选择不执行。研究发现，分享研究证据、提供适度的经济激励或为校长提供实施协助等措施并未产生显著效果；相比之下，额外的提醒电话将实施率提高了20个百分点。针对另一项强制性教育方案的第二次实验也得出了类似的结果：提醒措施产生了显著效果，而监督信息的效果则较为有限。我们的研究结果表明，官僚们对政策的关注度不足是阻碍政策推广的重要因素。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Consistent Probabilistic Social Choice Revisited
papers.abstract: Brandt et al. (2016) characterized a probabilistic social choice function known as maximal lotteries within a framework based on fractional preference profiles, which abstracts away from individual voters. While this modeling assumption enables a more elegant and transparent proof, it complicates comparison with other results in the literature. The purpose of this note is to transfer their results to the standard model of social choice, where each preference profile is defined for a finite number of voters. Along the way, we prove a slightly stronger version of their main theorem that uses a weaker continuity condition and allows for real-valued (rather than only rational-valued) probabilities.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】Brandt等人（2016年）在基于分数偏好配置的框架内，研究了一种被称为“最大彩票”（maximal lotteries）的概率社会选择函数。这种模型抽象掉了个体选民的因素。虽然这种建模假设使得证明过程更加简洁明了，但同时也增加了与文献中其他研究结果进行比较的难度。本文的目的是将他们的研究成果应用到标准的社会选择模型中，在该模型中，每个偏好配置都是针对有限数量的选民来定义的。在此过程中，我们证明了一个稍强版本的他们的主定理：该定理使用了较为宽松的连续性条件，并允许使用实数值概率（而不仅仅是理性数值概率）。。

papers.title: Iterative Elimination of Borda Losers: Axiomatizations of the Baldwin and Nanson Rules
papers.abstract: The Baldwin and Nanson rules are two voting rules proposed to identify the Condorcet winner whenever one exists. Both rules operate as recursive Borda elimination procedures: the Baldwin rule successively eliminates the alternatives with the lowest Borda score, whereas the Nanson rule eliminates all alternatives whose Borda scores do not exceed the mean. This paper investigates the axiomatic properties of the Baldwin and Nanson rules and provides unified axiomatic characterizations. In particular, our axioms are closely comparable to Young's (1974) characterization of the Borda rule.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】鲍德温规则（Baldwin rule）和南森规则（Nanson rule）是两种旨在确定存在康德赛特获胜者（Condorcet winner）时的投票规则。这两种规则均采用递归的博尔达淘汰法（recursive Borda elimination procedure）进行运作：鲍德温规则依次淘汰博尔达得分最低的候选者，而南森规则则淘汰所有博尔达得分未超过平均值的候选者。本文研究了鲍德温规则和南森规则的公理性质，并给出了统一的公理化描述。特别是，我们的公理与杨（Young, 1974）对博尔达规则的公理化描述高度相似。。

papers.title: Asymmetric Nonlinear Return Extrapolation and Optimal Portfolio Choice under Stochastic Volatility
papers.abstract: We extend the return extrapolation framework of Atmaz (2022) to incorporate two behaviorally realistic features absent from the linear benchmark: saturation in belief updating and asymmetry between gains and losses. We introduce a smooth, nonlinear, asymmetric extrapolation function and characterize the optimal portfolio of a CRRA investor under Heston (1993) stochastic volatility as the sum of a sentiment-distorted myopic demand, a variance hedging demand, and a sentiment hedging demand. The resulting semilinear Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation is solved by two independent numerical methods, a finite-difference ADI scheme with time-step policy iteration and a deep learning-driven iterative scheme. The model generates four investor-level behavioral anomalies: asymmetric responses to gains and losses, attenuated reactions at extremes, excess trading volume, and welfare loss rising with the strength of extrapolation, each of which maps onto documented empirical patterns. Its central finding is that saturation acts as an endogenous correction mechanism: at the same local slope at the origin, the asymmetric nonlinear extrapolator carries a smaller welfare loss than a linear one.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】我们扩展了Atmaz（2022）提出的回报外推框架，加入了两个在线性基准模型中缺失的、符合行为学现实的特征：信念更新的饱和效应以及收益与损失之间的不对称性。我们引入了一个平滑的、非线性的、具有不对称性的外推函数，并在Heston（1993）提出的随机波动性模型下，将CRRA投资者的最优投资组合描述为三种需求的总和：受情绪影响的短视需求、方差对冲需求以及情绪对冲需求。所建立的半线性Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程通过两种独立的数值方法求解，分别是基于时间步长策略迭代的有限差分ADI算法和基于深度学习的迭代算法。该模型揭示了四种投资者层面的行为异常现象：对收益和损失的不对称反应、在极端情况下反应的减弱、交易量的过度波动，以及随着外推强度增加而加剧的福利损失，这些现象均与现有的实证研究结果相符。我们的核心发现是：信念更新的饱和效应起到了一种内生修正机制的作用——在原点处具有相同局部斜率的情况下，非线性外推模型导致的福利损失小于线性模型。。研究方法：深度学习、随机过程。

papers.title: Limited belief propagation and contingent thinking
papers.abstract: An agent updates her beliefs over a set of variables after observing some of them. We provide a representation of updated beliefs that captures limited propagation of her observation's implications through the directed acyclic graph that represents the relations between all variables. Failure of contingent thinking occurs when she performs fewer inference steps from unobserved variables than observed ones, leading to correlation neglect and violations of iterated expectations. Our framework offers a new perspective on existing experiments about contingent thinking and suggests new directions. We characterize the model's relationship with familiar Bayesian and non-Bayesian benchmarks, and illustrate it with applications to public-good provision and social learning games.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】代理人在观察到部分变量后，会根据这些变量更新自己的信念。我们提出了一种表示更新后信念的方法，该方法能够捕捉到她的观察结果通过表示所有变量之间关系的有向无环图（DAG）所传递的信息的有限传播过程。当代理人从未观测到的变量中进行的推理步骤少于从已观测到的变量中进行的推理步骤时，就会发生条件性思维的失败，这会导致相关性被忽视以及迭代预期被违背。我们的框架为现有的关于条件性思维的实验提供了新的视角，并指出了新的研究方向。我们描述了该模型与常见的贝叶斯和非贝叶斯基准测试之间的关系，并通过公共物品供给和社会学习游戏的应用来对其进行说明。。研究方法：实验方法、贝叶斯方法。

papers.title: Commitment and the dynamics of household labor supply: new tests and evidence from Europe
papers.abstract: The ability of spouses to commit to future behavior has important implications for the allocation of resources between them and over time. Using a lifecycle collective model for household behavior, we propose new tests that distinguish between full, limited, and no commitment, based on the dynamic impact of wage shocks on household labor supply. A novelty of our approach is its ability to formally reject limited commitment, in addition to the other two types, exploiting sign restrictions from theory. We implement our tests across 15 European countries, drawing data from the EU-SILC over the years 2005-2019. We find that the elasticity of the Pareto weight with respect to favorable past wages is generally positive, consistent with bargaining under limited commitment. Past wage shocks thus induce bargaining effects on labor supply, empowering the recipient spouse and weakening the partner. Formally, we reject full and no commitment in all but 4 countries, but fail to reject limited commitment.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】配偶对未来行为的承诺能力对于他们之间以及长期内资源分配具有重要影响。我们采用生命周期集体模型来分析家庭行为，并提出新的检验方法，以区分完全承诺、有限承诺和无承诺三种情况，这些判断基于工资冲击对家庭劳动力供给的动态影响。我们方法的创新之处在于，除了能够识别其他两种承诺类型外，还能通过理论中的符号限制正式排除有限承诺的可能性。我们在15个欧洲国家进行了实证分析，数据来源于2005至2019年的欧盟劳动力调查（EU-SILC）。研究发现，帕累托权重对过去较高工资的弹性总体呈正相关，这与有限承诺下的讨价还价行为一致。因此，过去的工资冲击会引发劳动力供给方面的讨价还价行为，使获得较高工资的一方处于更有利地位，而另一方则处于相对弱势。从统计结果来看，我们在除4个国家外的所有国家都排除了完全承诺和无承诺的情况，但未能排除有限承诺的可能性。。

papers.title: Reducing Gun Violence at Scale
papers.abstract: Baltimore's homicide rate fell by roughly 60% between 2022 and 2025, an exceptional decline among large U.S. cities. At the start of this period, Baltimore launched a strategy that concentrated police and social service resources on a small set of people thought to be driving group-involved gun violence. The approach—“focused deterrence”—has been implemented in some form by cities across the U.S. The strategy was introduced first in the Western police district, one of the highest-violence communities in the U.S. Relative to comparable Baltimore neighborhoods, we estimate that within 18 months shootings and homicides in the Western district fell by roughly one third and carjackings by about 40%, with no spillovers elsewhere in the city. These gains came without expanding overall enforcement: total arrests were flat even as arrests for serious violent crimes rose sharply, indicating that the strategy redirected police authority toward serious violence rather than widening the net of the justice system. Person-level and qualitative evidence point to deterrence, incapacitation, services, and community messengers' legitimacy as contributing channels, with no single mechanism explaining the bulk of the decline. The social value of the averted violence is roughly 35 times the program's first-year spending. Citywide, Baltimore's homicide rate over this period was about 25% below a synthetic counterfactual built from other large cities. The timing of Baltimore's homicide decline and the absence of a larger-than-expected drop in other violent crimes are consistent with the expansion of focused deterrence across the city and a broader shift toward a targeted, partnership-based response to group violence. Baltimore's experience offers an important blueprint for how cities can achieve reductions in gun violence at scale.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】2022年至2025年间，巴尔的摩的凶杀率下降了约60%，这一降幅在美国各大城市中尤为显著。在这一时期初期，巴尔的摩实施了一项策略，将警察和社会服务资源集中投入到被认为是一系列群体性枪支暴力事件幕后黑手的少数人群身上。这种被称为“定向威慑”（focused deterrence）的方法已被美国多个城市采纳。该策略最初在西部警察辖区推行，该地区曾是美国暴力事件最为频发的地区之一。与巴尔的摩其他类似社区相比，我们估计在18个月内，西部辖区的枪击案和凶杀案减少了约三分之一，汽车劫持案减少了约40%，且这种效果并未波及城市的其他区域。尽管总体执法力度没有增加（总逮捕人数保持不变），但严重暴力犯罪的逮捕数量却大幅上升，这表明该策略将警力重点放在了打击严重暴力行为上，而非扩大司法系统的覆盖范围。从个体层面和定性证据来看，威慑效应、对犯罪分子的约束力、相关社会服务以及社区倡导者的影响力都是促成这一下降的重要因素，但没有单一机制能够完全解释这一显著变化。所避免的暴力事件所带来的社会价值大约相当于该项目第一年投入资金的35倍。在整个巴尔的摩市范围内，这一时期的凶杀率比基于其他大城市数据构建的“反事...。

papers.title: Post-Quantum Secure Federated DeFi for Inclusive Banking
papers.abstract: Recent advances in error-corrected qubits have accelerated the timeline for practical quantum computing. It poses a threat to cryptographic primitives used to secure financial systems, government infrastructure, communication networks, and DeFi (Decentralized Finance) ecosystems. This paper introduces a post-quantum secure federated DeFi framework that enables inter-bank collaboration to improve the inclusivity of individuals underserved by local lenders due to limited financial histories. Multiple banks contribute encrypted information batches to a virtual server, where lattice-based Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables end-to-end homomorphic computation. The server fuses local data-driven probabilistic assessments, expert beliefs, and verifiable evidence generated by the NASA-IBM Prithvi Geospatial Foundation Model (GFM), in encrypted format. Decentralized technologies are employed to ensure tamper-proof evidence and auditable accountability for all encrypted data exchanges between institutions and the server. The framework is tested on agricultural lending decisions for rural borrowers in Virginia.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】近期在纠错量子比特（error-corrected qubits）方面的技术进步加速了实用量子计算的发展进程。这给用于保护金融系统、政府基础设施、通信网络以及去中心化金融（DeFi）生态系统的加密技术带来了威胁。本文提出了一种后量子时代安全的联邦式去中心化金融（post-quantum secure federated DeFi）框架，该框架促进了银行间的合作，从而提高了那些因财务记录有限而难以获得本地贷款服务的个人的金融服务可及性。多家银行将加密信息批量上传至虚拟服务器，服务器利用基于格的完全同态加密（lattice-based Fully Homomorphic Encryption, FHE）技术实现端到端的同态计算。该框架融合了本地数据驱动的概率评估结果、专家意见，以及由NASA-IBM Prithvi地理空间基金会模型（NASA-IBM Prithvi Geospatial Foundation Model, GFM）生成的可验证证据（所有数据均以加密形式存储）。去中心化技术被应用于确保所有机构与服务器之间的加密数据交换具有防篡改性和可审计的透明度。该框架已在弗吉尼亚州...。
